title: V_(1,1,1) per-irrep character difference derivation via sign-rep substitution $\sigma_i \mapsto -q^{-1}$; closed form $-(q^2+1)^2(q^2-1)/(4q^5)$ proved via scalar arithmetic (conjugate-partition symmetry to V_(3))

Remark. V_(1,1,1) per-irrep character difference derivation via sign-rep substitution \sigma_i \mapsto -q^{-1}; closed form -(q^2+1)^2(q^2-1)/(4q^5) proved via scalar arithmetic (conjugate-partition symmetry to V_(3))

V_(1,1,1) per-irrep character via sign-rep substitution.

V_{(1,1,1)} constitutes the antisymmetric 1-d irrep of H_3(q). The character is derived directly via scalar arithmetic (analogous to V_{(3)}) using the sign-rep action:

  • \sigma_i \mapsto -q^{-1}
  • \sigma_i^{-1} \mapsto -q
  • averaged \mapsto -(q + q^{-1})/2

Applied to the canonical typed-\mathbf{B}_3 braids:

  • \mathcal{B}_p (uud): 6\sigma + 3\sigma^{-1} + 2 averaged
  • \mathcal{B}_n (udd): 5\sigma + 4\sigma^{-1} + 2 averaged

yields:

  • \chi_{(1,1,1)}(\mathcal{B}_p) = (-q^{-1})^6 \cdot (-q)^3 \cdot (-(q+q^{-1})/2)^2 = -q^{-3} \cdot (q+q^{-1})^2/4
  • \chi_{(1,1,1)}(\mathcal{B}_n) = (-q^{-1})^5 \cdot (-q)^4 \cdot (-(q+q^{-1})/2)^2 = -q^{-1} \cdot (q+q^{-1})^2/4

Difference (proved in chi_V111_difference_eq_factored):

  \chi_{(1,1,1)}(\mathcal{B}_n) - \chi_{(1,1,1)}(\mathcal{B}_p)
   = -\frac{(q^2 + 1)^2 (q^2 - 1)}{4 q^5}.

Conjugate-partition symmetry to V_(3)

The closed forms for V_(3) and V_(1,1,1) share the same numerator polynomial -(q^2 + 1)^2(q^2 - 1); they differ only by the denominator power (q vs q^5). The identity chi_V111_eq_chi_V3_div_q4 proves

\chi_{(1,1,1)}\text{-diff}(q) = \chi_{(3)}\text{-diff}(q) \,/\, q^4

formally. This is the conjugate-partition symmetry: (3) and (1,1,1) are transpose partitions, and the sign-rep \leftrightarrow trivial-rep duality manifests as the q \leftrightarrow -q^{-1} substitution on the generator level.
